description: Actively maintained, pure Java JDBC driver for Microsoft Access databases (.mdb, .accdb) requiring no native libraries. A maintained fork of the unmaintained net.sf.ucanaccess project, built on current Jackcess and HSQLDB versions with Java 11/17/21 support. Used by Java applications and JDBC client programs (e.g. OpenOffice, LibreOffice, SQuirreL SQL) to read and write Microsoft Access databases.
